title: Simulation of an Embedded Phase
statement: Let $k,l$ be natural numbers, $S,H$ types, and $x$ a Boolean input word. Let a source machine with $k$ work tapes and a host machine with $l$ work tapes be given, along with a tape embedding $\iota:\text{Fin}(k)\hookrightarrow\text{Fin}(l)$, a state embedding $e:S\hookrightarrow H$, an anchor state $a\in H$, and a predicate $P$ on source states. Suppose no state in the image of $e$ is $a$, and whenever $P(q)$ holds, the host transition at $e(q)$ agrees, for every input symbol and work-tape reading, with the embedded source transition followed by the state map $e$. For background tape contents and head positions, source configurations $c,d$, and $t\in\mathbb{N}$, suppose every source state reached at a time $j<t$ satisfies $P$, and the source run from $c$ reaches $d$ at time $t$. Then the host run from the embedded, state-mapped configuration of $c$ reaches the corresponding embedded, state-mapped configuration of $d$ at time $t$, and none of its configurations at times $0$ through $t$ has state $a$.
